clue.text: No thanks!

parts.note: read not as a polite refusal but as a description: the absence of any thanks, a failure to show gratitude

explanation.surface: Someone politely turns down an offer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ungratefulness is literally the giving of no thanks for a kindness received.

clue.text: The lowest point of a messy drain

indicators.note: messy says the letters of the next word are jumbled up

explanation.surface: The worst moment involved an untidy drain.
explanation.definitionFit: The nadir is the bottom-most point, the opposite of the zenith.

clue.text: Agent scoffs, but goes over it again

parts.note: a rep, representative, is a sales agent
to scoff food is to eat it greedily

explanation.surface: A sales agent gobbles his food, then has a second helping.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing or saying something again a second time is repetition.

clue.text: Rita managed to take four things which were not at all important

definitions.text: things which were not at all important

indicators.note: to take means the rearranged name holds the next piece inside it
managed suggests the name is handled and rearranged

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Rita handled four unimportant matters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'managed' makes TRIA from the name, and the Roman numeral sits in the middle of that jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Trivia are trifles, details of little consequence.

clue.text: Hair pieces can cause the greatest problems

parts.note: top means best or greatest
knots are tangles or difficulties

explanation.surface: Wigs can be the biggest trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can cause' is a link. 'Hair pieces' suggests wigs, but means tufts of hair tied on top of the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A topknot is a knot or tuft of hair worn on the crown.

clue.text: Determined policemen went into action

indicators.note: went into says the officers are placed inside the other word

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
CID, the Criminal Investigation Department, is the detective branch of British police

explanation.surface: Resolute officers sprang into action.
explanation.definitionFit: Being resolute means having one's mind firmly settled on something.

clue.text: Way to get rid of the professor of physics, perhaps?

definitions.text: Way to get rid of the professor of physics, perhaps?

parts.words: Way to get rid of the professor of physics, perhaps?
parts.note: a professorial post is a chair, and one in physics might be called by the subject that deals with current; also a means of execution

explanation.surface: Someone plots to remove an academic.
explanation.definitionFit: A seat wired to deliver a lethal shock, used for executions in some US states.

clue.text: Visitor left, throwing out caustic criticisms

indicators.note: throwing out suggests the letters are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: A guest departed, ejecting harsh insults.
explanation.definitionFit: Vitriol is sulphuric acid, and figuratively bitter, corrosive abuse.

clue.text: Easily excel at removing blemishes

definitions.meaning: literally taking spots off, as in cleaning marks from fabric

explanation.surface: Someone is brilliant at getting rid of stains.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for outclassing a rival, read literally as getting rid of marks.

clue.text: Pale, without a friend, took cover

indicators.note: without tells us to take the friend's letters away from the word for pale

parts.note: pallid means pale
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone pale and friendless ran for shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes PAL from PALLID, leaving the last three letters; 'took' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A lid is a top that covers a pot or box.

clue.text: Mischievous type starts a law suit under great pressure

indicators.note: starts says the first piece stands at the beginning, before the next one

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child or sprite
an action is a case brought in a court of law

explanation.surface: A naughty person begins legal proceedings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts' puts IMP at the front of ACTION; 'a' is a link word. The definition reads as a phrase describing a state of being wedged tight.
explanation.definitionFit: Impaction is the condition of being packed or wedged tightly, as an impacted tooth or bowel is.

clue.text: Pink vehicle used to race

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a race in the sense of a people is a nation

explanation.surface: A pink car is entered in a motor race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'race' looks like a motor contest but means a people; 'used to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The pink is a garden flower of the same family, and a carnation is one kind.

clue.text: Type of column made of some solid or icy material

indicators.note: made of some says the answer is made from part of the letters of the following words

parts.note: the letters run across the three words

explanation.surface: A pillar is built from something solid or frozen.
explanation.definitionFit: Doric is one of the classical orders of architecture, with plain capitals on its pillars.

clue.text: Leave quietly-good gracious!

parts.note: to go is to leave
sh is the word used to ask for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone is told to slip out silently and responds with surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are mild exclamations of surprise.

clue.text: Lets stick fall to get sweets

parts.note: gum is glue, something used to stick
drops are falls, as in sudden falls in level

explanation.surface: Someone allows a stick to fall to get some confectionery.
explanation.definitionFit: Gumdrops are chewy jelly confections.

clue.text: Assiduous boss had debts

parts.note: a boss is a knob or stud on a surface, as on a shield
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debt

explanation.surface: A hardworking manager was in the red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' suggests an employer but means a raised knob, a stud; 'had' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A studious person is diligent and careful in study, much as an assiduous one is persevering.

clue.text: Just fancy spring water

parts.note: a well is a spring of water
to well is to flow up like water

explanation.surface: Imagine mineral water.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of mild surprise, like 'fancy that'.

clue.text: Makes up a number

parts.note: reads like inventing a figure, but a number here is a song or piece of music being written

explanation.surface: Someone invents a statistic.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing a piece of music is creating a tune, which is what a songwriter does.

clue.text: Rocky place for hardy plants perhaps

definitions.meaning: a crop grown outside, as tough plants might be

explanation.surface: A rockery suits tough plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposed bedrock sticking up from the soil, and a crop grown outdoors.

clue.text: Mother had an afterthought about the plans

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
PS, postscript, is an afterthought added to a letter

explanation.surface: Mum added a note at the bottom about the arrangements.
explanation.definitionFit: Maps are charts or diagrams, as plans of a place are.

clue.text: Perpetually young animal carries oriental member back

indicators.note: carries says the animal holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: an ass is a donkey

indicators.note: back says these two pieces are read from right to left

parts.note: E for East, oriental meaning eastern
a leg is a limb or member

explanation.surface: An everlasting beast bears a limb from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the two pieces round to give GELE, and the donkey 'carries' that run inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ageless means never growing old, timeless.

clue.text: Susan's surname often has a novel appearance?

definitions.text: Susan's surname often has a novel appearance?

parts.words: Susan's surname often has a novel appearance?
parts.note: the American writer Susan with this surname had her name printed on the covers of novels

explanation.surface: A woman named Susan's surname turns up in books.
explanation.definitionFit: Susan Sontag was an American author of novels and essays.

clue.text: Some of Arthur's trunks are made of wood

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of Arthur's luggage is wooden.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads 'are made of wood' as 'a wood', the place-name sense of a hurst; 'trunks' suggests tree trunks to fit the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A hurst is an old word for a wooded hill or grove, as in place names.

clue.text: Wild animals might make less noise

indicators.note: might make says the letters of the following words could be rearranged to form the answer

explanation.surface: Fierce beasts might be quieter.
explanation.definitionFit: Female lions are big cats living wild on the savannah.

clue.text: You're not the first to get a wooden one!

definitions.text: You're not the first to get a wooden one!

parts.words: You're not the first to get a wooden one!
parts.note: a wooden one is the booby prize for coming last, which is certainly not first

explanation.surface: A consoling remark to someone who was given a piece of carved cutlery.
explanation.walkthrough: The wooden spoon is a mock prize given in Britain to whoever finishes last in a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden kitchen utensil is the traditional prize for last place.

clue.text: Tense and below par

definitions.meaning: in grammar a verb tense describing incomplete past action
below par means faulty or not up to standard

explanation.definitionFit: A grammatical form for unfinished past action, and also flawed or defective.

clue.text: Disgrace of a fool

indicators.note: to disgrace is to bring down or spoil, so the two little words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fool brings shame on himself.
explanation.definitionFit: An oaf is a clumsy, stupid person.

clue.text: Saying sorry for spoiling ago

annotationWithheld.why: Saying sorry for spoiling ago: SPOILING AGO are the eleven letters of the answer, so 'spoiling' must be both fodder and anagram indicator; no search found another version of the clue.
